Commentary.Commentary: Dasun Shanaka was the pick of the bowlers as he was the only bowler to not leak runs. After being slaughtered by Head, Malinga came back strongly in the 19th over, conceding just 5 runs and picking up a couple of wickets. None of the bowlers were that effective as they all went for runs. It looks a good batting wicket but chasing a target of 188 won't be easy. Join us in a while for the chase to check if the Sri Lankans can again pull it off and whitewash the Aussies at their own backyard.

Head and Dunk did some damage but could not give the opener Klinger company for long. The latter kept on going with the bat as he too reached his maiden T20I fifty. With a platform set for the upcoming batsmen at 167/2 in 17 overs, they only managed to score 20 runs off the last 3 overs thanks to some brilliant death bowling by the Lankans.

A brilliant bowling effort by the visiting team in the end as they did not let the hosts cross the 200-run mark. Finch and Klinger started off really well as they stitched in a partnership of 79 runs for the opening wicket. The skipper made it a point of making the Islanders pay after being dropped on naught and getting to his 7th T20I fifty.
Superb stuff to end the innings! Bowls it wide outside off, Henriques manages to steer it to the backward point fielder for a single. Just 5 runs off the over!  AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 187/6!
Back of a length delivery, pulled through front of square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Tim looks to slash it but misses.
Leg bye! Angling down leg, Moises miss his flicks and gets it off his pads on the leg side. Leg bye taken!
Tim Paine will replace James Faulkner in the middle.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Fullish delivery on middle and off, Faulkner looks to go big over long on but fails to middle it. It goes straight into the hands of Kapugedera, who is having a great time out on the field.
Full on middle and leg, dug out through mid on for a couple.
Dasun Shanaka will bowl the last over.
James Faulkner is the next man in.

OUT! Malinga strikes again! Low full toss, Turner in search of runs looks to slog over mid on. Kapugedera in the deep runs ahead and completes a superb catch. Australia are losing the plot here! 5 runs and 3 wickets in the over!
Full outside off, driven to cover-point. The fielder there makes a sharp fielding effort and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single completed!
On the pads, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Ashton Turner walks out in the middle.

OUT! Klinger is run out! On the pads, clipped through backward square leg. Klinger comes back for the second. Shanaka in the deep picks the ball and hurls a flat throw at the keeper's end. Mendis calmly collects the ball and whips the bails off. It is referred upstairs and the replays show that Klinger didn't make his ground.
Moises Henriques is the next man in.

OUT! The dangerous Head departs!  Head once more looks to loft the full toss over mid off. Doesn't get into the right position and also fails to get the distance. Kapugedera at long off, stretches his hands high and completes a good catch.
Head lofts the low full toss over mid off and takes another couple.
Klinger hits it through mid off. Head and Klinger are quick between the wickets and complete a couple. Can Australia cross the 200-run mark?
FOUR! Angling down leg, Klinger works it down the leg side for a boundary. Great placement!
Full on off, lofted over mid off for a single.

Full outside off, Travis lofts it over covers. The substitute fielder, Udana in the deep, runs to his left and puts in a dive. The umpires have a check and the replays show that he has saved a certain boundary. Two runs added to the total!
Fullish delivery, angling across, Head goes for a slog but gets it off the inner half of the bat, back to the bowler.
Slower one, Klinger reads it and slogs it through mid-wicket for a single.
Head goes for another biggie but ends up inside edging it onto his own pads. Dot to end the over! 20 runs off a Malinga over! That's some batting from Head!
FOUR! Another boundary! TH camps back and lofts it over mid off. The ball bounces just before the ropes for a boundary.
It seems a good batting performance by the Aussies. They will want to post a daunting total here.
Fuller delivery, driven through mid off for a brace.
SIX! Back-to-back biggies! Head goes back in his crease and slogs the slower delivery over long on for another maximum.
SIX! Misses out on yorker, ends up bowling a very full delivery on the boots, clipped over backward square leg for a biggie! Superb shot that!
Yorker on middle and leg, Klinger goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
No ball! Beamer! The ball slips out of Malinga's hand and goes down the leg side. No ball is signalled!
The death overs specialist, Lasith Malinga is back on!
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Angling down leg, tickled fine down the leg side for three runs.
Maiden T20I fifty for Michael Klinger!

FOUR! Length delivery, Klinger stays back and pulls this one over mid-wicket. Goes one bounce into the stands. A boundary is signalled! With that shot, has managed to reach his fifty. Superb knock by the 37-year old!
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
On the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.

Full outside off, driven through covers. The fielder there stops the ball and hurls a throw at the bowler's end seeing Klinger out of his crease. Misses his shy and the batsmen run through for an overthrow.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Pitched outside off, MK opens the face of his bat and guides it through to third man for a single.
Angling into the pads, worked through front of square leg for a brace.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Slower delivery in the line of the stumps, eased on to long on for a single.
Outside off, guided through point for a single.
Nuwan Kulasekara is back into the attack.
Travis Head walks out in the middle with only 6 over left.

OUT! Shanaka wins the battle! Went for the boundary on the second delivery, came back strongly with three dots. Pressure built on Dunk and he miscued a length delivery angling across high in the air. Prasanna at point took a couple of steps towards the deep and grabbed the ball cleanly. Can SL finish strongly?
Third dot in a row! The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. Good over so far by Shanaka!
Very full outside off, in the blockhole. BD looks to run it down but misses.
Back of a length delivery, mistimes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Dunks shuffles way across, Shanaka follows him by bowling it very full outside off. Dunk adjusts well and opens the face of his bat very late. Gets a boundary through third man.
Full outside off, tapped on the bounce to the point fielder.

FOUR! The margin for error is minimal in this format of the game! Vikum goes for a yorker but misses it by just. Ends up bowling a low full toss on the boots, Klinger clips it superbly through forward square leg for a boundary. 17 runs off it!
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
SIX! In the arc, out of the park! Full delivery on middle and leg, Dunk gets his front leg out of the way and slogs it high and handsome over mid-wicket for a biggie!
FOUR! Superb innovation! Low full toss on the stumps, Dunk moves a long way across and scoops it over the keeper's head. There's not protection in the deep there and gets a boundary for it.
Leg bye! Fuller on the boots, Klinger misses his clip. The ball goes off the boots to short fine leg. A leg bye is taken!
Low full toss, eased onto long on for a single.
Full toss, BD mistimes his pull to long on for a single.
Outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Slower one on length, MK looks to run it down but is beaten by the lack of pace on it.
Angling into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket. It's a long boundary in that region which allows the batsmen to take another couple.
Pitched wide outside off, MK slaps it through backward point. The fielder there dives to his left, making a half stop. This allows the batsmen to take a couple.
Fuller delivery around off, eased onto long off for a single.
Dasun Shanaka replaces Asela Gunaratne for his first over of the night.
Full toss on the pads, played to long on for a single.

A tough chance gone down! Fuller on middle and leg, dug out uppishly straight back. Sanjaya looks to catch it in his followthrough but fails to hold onto it. He is hurt there and Malinga is stretching his arms.
Full and wide outside off, Dunk looks to run it down but misses.
Full delivery around off, off driven by Dunk. The short extra cover fielder cuts it out with a dive to his left.
Good comeback from Sanjaya! Fires in a yorker on middle and leg, swings in late. Dunk does well to keep it out.
SIX! Fuller on middle and off, Dunk stays tall and heaves it over wide long on. Clears the man in the deep by just and gets his first maximum of the night.
Vikum Sanjaya is back into the attack.
Slower delivery into the stumps, Klinger stays in his crease and defends it well.
Dunk stays deep in his crease and pushes it towards long off for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Klinger drives it towards long on for a single.
SIX! WHACKED! Length delivery in the line of the stumps, Klinger stays in his crease and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. That was a top shot there.
On the pads, Dunk clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Outside off on a fuller length, Klinger drives it through the cover region for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, even the keeper cannot collect it. The ball tickles away towards short fine leg and the batsmen run a single.
The man of the moment, Asela Gunaratne is introduced into the attack now!
Short into the stumps, Ben Dunk punches it towards extra cover to keep strike with a single.
Floated outside off, Klinger drives it through the cover region for a single.
Klinger gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it straight back to the bowler.
Ben Dunk walks in at no.3!

OUT! SKIPPER FINCH DEPARTS! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Finch moves on the leg side and just hoists it over the extra cover region. Siriwardana who is standing at wide long off moves a bit towards his left and takes a fine catch. Prasanna celebrates with a dab! Finch has to go back into the hut just after completing his fifty but well after paying the Lankans for that drop chance.
Outside off, Finch has let that through.
Fuller outside off, Klinger drives it through covers for a single.
7th T20I fifty for Finch!

SIX! OUT OF THE PARK! Full delivery on the pads, Finch gets to the pitch of the ball and just slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region. This ball was way into the stands and this guy has made the Lankans play after he got a life initially.
Again on the pads, Klinger clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short into the pads, Finch flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman.
Short and wide outside off, Finch slaps it through the extra cover region. Asela runs from the long off region and cuts it to stop the boundary. The players manage to run a couple.
Short on the pads, Finch works it through the square leg region for a quick couple.
Milinda Siriwardana is on now!
Finch camps back and pushes it through the cover-point region to regain strike. Good over this for the Sri Lankans.
On the pads, Klinger clips it towards wide mid on for a single.
Klinger camps back and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Floated up, Finch drives it through the cover region for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Finch stays deep and cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Short into the stumps, Klinger stays deep in his crease and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Klinger drives it through covers to keep strike.
Klinger drives the full delivery straight to the fielder at covers.
Wide! Full toss delivery down the leg side, Klinger tries to clip it fine but misses. Wide is signalled by the umpire.
Huge shout for LBW! Maling angles it again on the pads, Klinger gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes towards the fielder at point. The players appeal but the umpire denies it.
Again spayed on the pads by Malinga, Klinger clips it fielrcely through the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Again a full delivery on the pads, Finch clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Full toss on the pads, Finch says thank you and flicks it past the diving short third man fielder for a boundary.
Lasith Malinga is back for a bowl.
Finch cuts it through point for a single.
SIX! POWERFUL! Tossed up between middle and leg, Finch stays deep in his crease and plays an inside out shot over the cover region for a biggie. That was brutal!
Again down the leg side, Finch clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
FOUR! Short outside off, Finch camps back and cuts it over the fielder at covers for a boundary.
On the pads, Klinger clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Tossed outside off, Klinger gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. That is a good start to the over for the Aussies.
Spin in the fifth over as the quickies are going for runs. Seekkuge Prasanna with the ball in his hands.

OUCH! Fuller delivery into the stumps, Finch comes a touch forward and drives it back to the bowler. Nuwan makes a fine stop and has a throw back at the stumps. Finch dives back and gets hit on his back. That one might have hurt him real bad.
FOUR! Again down the leg side, Finch gets forward and clips it through the short fine leg region for another boundary. Beautiful shot!
Fuller delivery outside off, Finch drives it on the off side but cannot get it through the gap. The extra cover fielder stops it and no runs are taken.
Outside off on a length, Finch cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! On the pads, Finch flicks it gracefully over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. He is taking the attack to the bowlers.
Fuller delivery on the stumps, Klinger drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Full toss on the stumps, Klinger drives it through mid on for a single.

FOUR! Fuller delivery into the stumps, Klinger just lofts it over the the mid on region region. Tharanga gives it a good chase and tries to stop it with a dive just before the fence. The umpires check it upstairs and the replays show that Tharanga made contact with the rope and the ball at the same time. So, it's signalled as boundary.
Length ball around off, Finch tries to square it on the leg side but he gets a leading edge towards point.
Full toss delivery on the pads, Finch clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side, Finch tries to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper. The umpire signals it as a wide.
FOUR! Good shot! Angled into the pads, Finch makes room for himself and lofts it over the extra cover region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off to start with, Finch pushes it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Change in bowling as Vikum Sanjaya has been brought on into the attack!
Sprayed on the pads, Finch flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single. 14 runs off the over!
Outside off on a length, Klinger cuts it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Length delivery outside off, Klinger gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it uppishly over the fielder at mid off.
On the pads, Klinger clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Finch digs it out on the off side and gets a single.

SIX! TOP SHOT! Length delivery in the line of the stumps, Finch stays in his crease and just heaves it over widish mid on for a biggie. Straight from the middle of the bat and the ball goes the distance.
Wide! Way wide outside off, Finch still goes for it but misses it completely. The umpire has signaled it as a wide.
Nuwan Kulasekara will share the new ball.
Good length delivery outside off, swinging away. Klinger tries to poke at it but he is beaten by the away movement.

DROPPED! Angling into the pads, Finch clips it straight to Munaweera at short mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a mockery of a simple chance as he puts it down and the batsmen take a single. Finch gets his first run. How costly will be this drop?
Fourth dot ball in a row and the fourth one played from the middle of the bat. This time Finch plays it towards the fielder at mid off.
Slinging delivery again on a length and Finch pushes this one straight to the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Finch pushes it towards the cover fielder.

Good length delivery outside off, Finch stays deep in his crease and defends it towards covers. Klinger calls for a run but is sent back by Finch so that saves him. A direct hit at the bowler's end would have been close.

The players have made their way out on the field. Michael Klinger walks out with his skipper, Aaron Finch. Lasith Malinga to begin the proceedings with the ball for the final time in the series. Here we go...

TEAM NEWS - Australia make one change as Adam Zampa replaces Andrew Tye. Sri Lanka have one forced change as Dasun Shanaka comes in for the suspended Niroshan Dickwella. Kusal Mendis will don the gloves in his absence.
TOSS - Upul Tharanga wins the toss for the third time in a row. SRI LANKA WILL FIELD FIRST.

Hello and a warm welcome for the final T20I between Australia and Sri Lanka. The Islanders have already managed to seal the deal as they have taken a 2-0 lead in the 3-match series. They will be itching to win their last game and take the revenge of the 2-0 series loss at home against the Kangaroos by clean sweeping the hosts. On the other hand, the home team will look to play for pride as they are yet to register their first win in this series. So with both teams having a point to prove, entertainment is imminent! Stay tuned for the toss!
